llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed teaching assistant for generating student progress and renewal reports, with sensitive student-data use called out and bounded by confirmation and consent requirements.

dimensions.detail: The skill reads and writes shared student workspace data involving minors, but this access is purpose-aligned, field-scoped, disclosed, and paired with pseudonym use, consent checks, and data-control commands.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of markdown skill instructions and reference templates; no executable scripts, package install steps, network calls, or hidden setup mechanism were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation examples are broad and include natural phrases and usage thresholds, but the runtime instructions keep actions within report generation, require real recorded data, and state that teachers confirm before parent communication.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to parent communication logs routed through the parent-communication skill after teacher confirmation; it explicitly forbids automatic sending and requires consent for cross-skill sharing or profile creation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: it summarizes lesson records, progress evidence, course-package status, and renewal context to draft staged reports and parent-facing renewal language.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill use recorded student lesson, progress, and course-package data to draft reports. Confirm the student alias and consent status before generation, review all outputs before sending, and keep real names, family details, and unsupported performance claims out of reports.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad report and renewal trigger phrases are consistent with the skill's purpose, but users should treat them as suggestions and confirm the target student before loading or generating reports.
[SQP-1] expected: The 50% and 70% course-package milestones are purpose-aligned renewal-report triggers; the artifact could define precedence more precisely, but it does not authorize hidden sending or uncontrolled writes.
